prompts.text: Our checkout service runs on http://127.0.0.1:8000. Some coupon checkouts fail with a 500 and I cannot see why. Put Faultline in front of it on port 8700 and tell me the proxy URL to point the storefront at.

The storefront just hit it. Find the failing request in Faultline, tell me exactly why it fails, and fix the cause in checkout_logic.py. The service hot-reloads. Then replay the failed trace to prove it.
